backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, prompts, and categories with authorization checks and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related files, components, and test references.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files such as components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide explaining how to diagnose deployment failures, gather logs, and apply common fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file setting up the root element and favicon links and loading the React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component handling authentication, backend sync, prompt management, and UI layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign‑in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/backend/BackendC: Displays backend connection loading and error banners with optional reload action.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Provides UI for filtering prompts by favorites or category with selectable badges.
Lets users add new categories and select existing ones via checkboxes with paste handling.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming or deleting categories with usage counts and confirmation flow.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: Handles prompt import/export to JSON files and syncs imported data to backend.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Reusable confirmation dialog with title, description, and confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Action buttons for copying, favoriting, duplicating, editing, and deleting a prompt.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Renders sanitized HTML prompt content safely inside the UI.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing prompts with title, rich text content, and category selection.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Displays prompts in a responsive grid with title, categories, preview content, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Shows prompts in a vertical list with full categories, content preview, and action controls.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Renders a dialog showing the full prompt title and content when previewing.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Presents prompts in a table with sortable fields, row-click preview, and action buttons.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Search input with icon and paste-cleaning handler for filtering prompts.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown allowing users to select sorting modes for prompts.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Buttons to switch between list, grid, and table view modes.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Handles safe Internet Identity logout URL creation and full-page logout navigation with session tracking.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Provides a fixed return URL containing the required admin token hash for post-logout redirects.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook orchestrating reliable logout by clearing local auth, waiting for identity changes, then triggering provider logout.
frontend/src/features/backend/actorDiagn: Diagnostic logging utilities for backend actor creation, connectivity, and configuration errors.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: Maps prompt and category types between frontend and backend and provides CRUD API wrappers using a backend actor.
frontend/src/features/backend/useBackend: React hook that tracks backend actor readiness, loading, and errors with diagnostic logging.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Synchronizes prompts and categories with the backend, performs connectivity checks, and loads data after authentication.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category lists with add, rename, delete, set, and clear operations.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: Provides a hook to copy text to clipboard with modern and fallback methods and a temporary copied state.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories to a JSON file with metadata.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts and categories from a JSON file, validating data and resolving ID collisions.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data structure and validates imported prompt data formats.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted text from plain text or HTML, removing artifacts and preserving structure.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Generates paste handlers that clean pasted text for inputs and contentEditable elements.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case-insensitive search across fields.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates unique IDs for prompts using timestamp and randomness.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompts with add, update, delete, duplicate, favorite, and category operations.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by date added, date modified, alphabetical order, or favorites-first mode.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines Prompt structure and view/sort mode string unions.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML to plain text by stripping tags and normalizing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Cleans HTML by removing unsafe tags, normalizing spans/colors, and preserving allowed formatting.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: Implements a basic rich text editor with bold, italic, and color controls using contentEditable.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves UI viewMode preferences to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: React hook that auto-persists viewMode changes to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages backend actors based on identity, refreshing dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identities, and auth client setup.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light/dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op favicon setter kept for compatibility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, QueryClient, and identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, fonts, and plugins like typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current issues with backend actor initialization in production and listing feature requests to improve error handling and connectivity checks.
